commitResults.messageBody: Package the shared split-view diff workflow inside the project so future Codex sessions can generate a self-contained HTML review of repository changes. Include the skill instructions, invocation metadata, and standard-library generator to keep the workflow reproducible for all project contributors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for marking tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody: Track completion separately from task descriptions so list output can show each task's current status without introducing new classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for unmarking completed tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Reuse the existing completion state so users can reverse a task's done status without adding new classes.
Define a reusable test-ui skill and runner, and require agents to review the UI test plan and execute it after code changes so user-visible behavior is checked consistently.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use an enum for chatbot command types
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize command keywords in CommandType and route input through an exhaustive switch so command handling no longer depends on repeated free-form strings. Preserve exact matching for no-argument commands and add regression coverage for unexpected list and bye arguments.
